body:
Path: write metadata — Studio's code stays workable | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: closed as not planned. A behaviour-preserving split has no `reach:`, so it is not a card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:10Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (5,547 lines, `wc -l` on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a code-health split with no user-facing reach is not a card. Without `reach:`, a finding goes to Acceptance notes with a `carrier:` (`filing-gate.md:20`).

- **Why not the decision box:** how a file is split is the claimant's call, not a product decision.
- **Why not on its own:** several open Studio cards edit this file (objectui#11794 and #11795, graded today, among others). A standalone split would conflict with each of them.
- **carrier:** a claimant whose card edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` may move the region it changes into its own module in the same diff (the body's option B), and say so in Acceptance notes.
